digest.component_or_area: CI/static analysis gates and linting infrastructure
propositions: The scripts/ directory (41 files, 7 CI-invoked) is excluded from all static gates (Makefile sources, mypy scope) despite containing workflow tooling that blocks the Verified vote.

ruff check scripts/ reports 78 violations: 50 T201 (print discipline exemption desired), 12 RUF100 (dead noqa directives), 11 E501 (line-too-long rewrap), 2 RUF005 (collection concatenation), 2 RUF059 (unused unpacks), 1 B905 (zip without strict=), plus 1 RUF036 undercounted; ruff format --check scripts/ finds 7 files needing reformatting.
The 28 substantive violations (RUF100, E501, RUF005, RUF059, B905, RUF036) must be resolved; no live defects present.

T201 exemption must consolidate nine single-file per-file-ignores entries into one directory-level "scripts/**" = ["T201"] entry while removing all 28 redundant inline '# noqa: T201' directives in one atomic change to avoid introducing new RUF100 violations.
Five RUF100 directives referencing non-enabled rules (PLC0415, S603, S310, PLR0915) must be confirmed to document no live intent before deletion, with live rationale preserved as plain comments.

scripts/ must be added to Makefile sources variable so make lint covers it, with ruff check/format scripts/ clean and CI green; all seven CI-invoked gate scripts must produce identical behavior before and after.
